description: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE mirroring Quaderno's published VAT/GST/sales-tax rate lookup data specification (country, tax name, standard/digital-goods rate, registration threshold and period), illustratively populated for AU GST plus the initiative's other target/EU markets relevant to a live-event ticketing platform's tax-compliance workflow.
spec_note: SYNTHETIC: field shape (country, tax_name, standard/digital-goods rate, registration threshold) mirrors the structure of Quaderno's public tax-rate-lookup product; direct re-verification of Quaderno's own rate-table page returned a 404 on this fetch, so field names are a best-effort mirror of the well-known VAT/GST-rate-lookup pattern rather than a page-confirmed schema. Headline AU/UK/India/Canada/Germany statutory rates shown are real published rates used only as realistic illustrative inputs; threshold figures are simplified illustrative examples and change over time — NOT licensed Quaderno data and NOT tax advice.

records.registration_threshold_local: AUD 75,000 (non-resident digital: no threshold, mock illustrative)
USD 100,000 or 200 transactions - typical economic nexus threshold (mock illustrative, varies by state)
INR 2,000,000 (mock illustrative; non-resident OIDAR: no threshold)
EUR 10,000 (EU-wide OSS distance-selling threshold, mock illustrative)
